title: PawXAI
tagline: Your best Web3 information assistant on Telegram, learn the Latest News, Track the Latest Trends
description:
PawXAI — Your Web3 Intelligence Assistant on Telegram

PawXAI is your all-in-one Web3 information assistant, designed to help users stay ahead of the market — learn faster, track trends smarter, and trade with confidence.
Built as a Telegram bot, PawXAI provides a seamless and intuitive user experience right where the crypto community already lives.

Why We Built It
The crypto world moves fast — and the flood of information makes it difficult to keep up.
Too Noisy: The market is overwhelmed with scattered news and endless tweets.
Too Late: By the time users find valuable insights, it’s often old news.
Too Hard: Extracting credible and actionable data takes too much time and effort.

That’s why we built PawXAI — to cut through the noise and deliver real-time, meaningful information directly to your Telegram chat.

What PawXAI Offers
PawXAI transforms information overload into actionable intelligence. Within Telegram, users can:
💬 Chat with the Latest Twitter Trends — Instantly discover what’s happening right now.
🧠 Analyze Any Twitter Account — Get summarized insights and engagement metrics.
🔍 Find the Right KOLs — Identify influencers that match your interests or goals.
🏦 Track On-Chain Addresses — Analyze wallet activities, holdings, and token exposure.
⚡ Trade Smarter — Make faster, data-driven decisions powered by real-time AI insights.
how_its_made:
PawXAI integrates AI Agent systems, On-chain data, and Twitter analytics to provide a complete, intelligent view of the Web3 landscape — all inside a single Telegram bot.
Stay informed, react instantly, and never miss an opportunity again.
